items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible fleet growth; counsel_required for upstream source rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, vendor/DPA obligations, and future affiliate or advertising use. Exact decision: keep the gated product private. Evidence: official API documentation establishes access mechanics but not rights to store, transform, cache, display, alert on, or monetize returned data; current public terms point against the proposed use. Fleet compliance is technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown. Analytics and revenue attribution are yellow; aggregate commission remains unattributed. Do not claim certification, ROI, or site-attributed revenue.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks are closed. Partial evidence exists for official API documentation and terms, backend/configuration data-flow files, privacy and cookie pages, and draft terms; no task has complete evidence. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering source fields, provenance, permitted storage/display/alerts, freshness, correction, takedown, alert identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Keep outreach unsent and preserve the private gate.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required and launch-blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance and rights, storage/caching/display/alert terms, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price limits, and affiliate or advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; produce the repository/deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed; capture existing consent, withdrawal, GA4 property, data-sharing, retention, and jurisdiction evidence without enabling tracking. Operational logs and hosting data are evidence_needed; produce a read-only log-field, retention, access, vendor/DPA, incident, and request-procedure inventory.

Ordinary reversible growth remains conditional, not generally blocked by incomplete telemetry. It may proceed only where site-specific consent, privacy/cookie disclosure, terms, affiliate disclosure, claims, data provenance and rights, copyright/trademark boundaries, and platform-policy constraints are evidenced. Do not add tracking, expand monetization, publish unsupported claims, or extend affiliate use on failed or unknown compliance sites.
